request.prompt:
Use the Seolmin character image as the identity guide and the opening reference frame as the motion seed. Use a bright 16:9 classroom frame. Keep Seolmin visibly standing on the right quarter of frame, full body or medium-wide, and keep the left three-quarters a clean green chalkboard reserved for post typography. She faces the viewer first, then gives a small inviting gesture toward the empty board as if asking a fill-in-the-blank question. Keep the board completely clean and text-free. No answer reveal, no chalk marks, no subtitles, and no decorative writing anywhere.

Composition: Keep Seolmin as the same bright platinum-haired chibi Korean classroom host with her gat and cheerful expression. Use a 16:9 horizontal classroom frame. Keep her visibly standing on the right quarter of frame and keep the left three-quarters a clean green chalkboard reserved for post typography. Do not center her, do not hide her behind the board, and do not reveal the answer word on props, surfaces, or gestures before the answer scene.

AVOID: text, letters, Korean characters, subtitles, numbers, logos, watermarks, chalk writing, calligraphy, labels, decorative writing, extra characters, extra limbs, photorealistic, dark horror tone, blurry, low quality, generic teacher swap
